scope: Minimal optional Linux echo component experiments; no production RPC policy/flag change.

shared_owner.hypothesis: A lowest-free shared lane can migrate its native caller-pumped IO context across caller threads. Source supports the possibility; measurement must determine its importance.
shared_owner.resources: Eight distinct physical NUMA1 cores for client and server, metadata separate; SCHED_OTHER/nice0 roles, metadata nice10; private loopback network/mount namespace.
shared_owner.confound: One versus32 Client wrappers and cleanup threads;32socketFD prime snapshot is not continuous connection-activity proof.

paired_dispatch.hypothesis: Net effect of avoiding Asio-to-bthread and bthread-to-Asio handoffs for an in-memory echo only.
paired_dispatch.base: Pinned source plus identical relaxed atomic declaration and extern-C count getter; all dispatch remains production bthread.
paired_dispatch.inline: Only exact diag.echo after successful Admit and attachment release uses Respond(Run(request)), Finish, return plus counterincrement.
paired_dispatch.diag_prime_and_other_methods: Unchanged bthread path in both variants; cooperative prime may wait and must never be inlined.
paired_dispatch.ownership: One admitted job is finished once on normal echo completion; unchanged Respond owns reply attachments; prime/port captures outlive Release then Server.Stop.
paired_dispatch.server_CLI: serve 127.0.0.1 READY_FILE only, no call mode.
paired_dispatch.counter: Counts branch entries, not successes; root controller validates base0/inline12288 after Stop plus independent full client byte/error/cohort checks.
paired_dispatch.nonblocking_only: The registered diag.echo handler only moves memory. Never use this private path for Worker or potentially blocking business logic.
paired_dispatch.interpretation: Net component screen, not a directional stage decomposition or guaranteed mathematical lower bound; atomic and code-layout effects remain.
